categories.main_business_segments: A-Living Smart City Services Co., Ltd. operates primarily in four business segments: property management services, property owners value-added services, city services, and extended value-added services. Property management services include security, cleaning, greening, gardening, repair, and maintenance. Property owners value-added services focus on living and comprehensive services, home improvement, community space operations, and services to institutions and enterprises. City services cover street cleaning, refuse collection, landscaping, municipal facility maintenance, and smart city management solutions. Extended value-added services mainly involve sales centre property management and other services for property developers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages a four-tier quality control system and integrates digital transformation and smart technologies, including an online energy consumption management platform and a 'Smart Compound' system for proactive service management. It employs grid-based management and online-offline integration for quality inspections and customer service. The company also collaborates with technology partners like Alipay to implement contactless visitor registration and enhances operational efficiency through digital platforms and intelligent human-machine integration solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers include property owners and residents of residential, public, commercial, and office buildings across China. The company also serves institutional clients such as educational institutions, government office buildings, cultural and sports venues, parks, and major corporations including China Pacific Insurance, CNOOC, and ICBC. The services cater to mid- to high-end property markets, focusing on enhancing living and working experiences and preserving property value.
categories.geographic_coverage: A-Living operates nationwide in China, covering 30 provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions, with projects in 205 cities. Key regional concentrations include the Yangtze River Delta (31.6% of GFA under management), Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (19.5%), Shandong Peninsula city cluster (8.0%), and Chengdu-Chongqing city cluster (7.9%). The company emphasizes regional clustering and has a balanced portfolio across residential, public, and commercial properties.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the property management supply chain. It provides comprehensive property management and value-added services directly to property owners and residents, as well as city services related to urban maintenance and sanitation. It also engages in asset-light service models and supply chain building for self-operated products, establishing direct cooperation with manufacturers and brands to enhance competitiveness.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing service quality, operational efficiency, and sustainable business development. The company focuses on digital transformation, smart city solutions, and intelligent human-machine integration to improve service precision and customer experience. It pursues innovation in service models, quality management systems, and asset-light strategies while strengthening frontline talent development and brand identity. The company also emphasizes risk control, cash flow management, and phased withdrawal from underperforming projects.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through service fees from property management, value-added services, city services, and extended value-added services. The company primarily uses lump sum contract basis for property management services, which supports service quality and operational efficiency. Revenue streams include ongoing service contracts, sales of goods related to value-added services, and fees for specialized institutional and commercial services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: A-Living is positioned as a leading mid- to high-end comprehensive property management service provider in China, with a strong market presence and diversified portfolio. It holds a competitive edge in scale and quality, particularly in public buildings and high-tier cities. The company is recognized among the top 100 property management companies in China and has received multiple awards for quality, market-oriented operation, ESG development, and digital excellence. It competes by focusing on service quality, innovation, and regional clustering.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2024, the company managed a gross floor area (GFA) of approximately 550.6 million sq.m. with a contracted GFA of about 723.1 million sq.m. Revenue for 2024 was RMB 13.87 billion, a 10.2% decrease from 2023, with a net loss of RMB 3.13 billion primarily due to increased impairment losses and economic challenges. Despite the loss, the company maintains substantial total assets of RMB 20.25 billion and shareholders’ equity of RMB 11.15 billion. The company is focusing on quality-driven growth and operational efficiency amid a challenging real estate market.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: A-Living emphasizes high-quality, comprehensive, and customer-centric property management services with a focus on service excellence, innovation, and sustainability. Its value proposition includes delivering services that are fairly priced, worth the price, and exceed customer expectations, thereby preserving and enhancing property value. The company differentiates itself through a diversified business portfolio, advanced digital and smart city solutions, a strong quality control system, and a commitment to community engagement and social responsibility.
